parts.text: Write a 1200–1400 word (REQUIRED) high-authority SEO product review in clean HTML designed for maximum search ranking, excellent blog UX, and strong commercial conversion. Product: {{20.name}} Focus keyword: {{52.result}} Product URL: {{20.permalink}} IMPORTANT OUTPUT RULES - Return ONLY raw HTML. - Do NOT wrap in markdown. - Do NOT use ``` blocks. - Do NOT include explanations. - Generate ONLY the HTML intended for inside a WordPress post body. - Do NOT include , , , , , or <body>. - Do NOT insert <br> tags. - Do NOT create empty <p> tags. - Start directly with <h1>. CONTENT STYLE - Write like a professional technology review website. - Maintain high authority tone but easy readability. - Use short paragraphs (2–3 lines). - Use bullet lists frequently. - Avoid fluff or repetitive phrases. - Focus on real user value and practical insights. SEO RULES - Use semantic HTML elements: <h1>, <h2>, <h3>, <ul>, <li>, <strong>, <table>, <blockquote>. - Optimize for commercial search intent. - Use natural keyword variations. - Maintain logical heading hierarchy. - Target both informational and transactional queries. KEYWORD RULES - Include the focus keyword in: • the <h1> • the first 100 words • at least 3 <h2> headings • naturally 8–12 times throughout the article ARTICLE STRUCTURE (MANDATORY) <h1> Use the focus keyword naturally. INTRODUCTION Write a strong introduction explaining: - what the product is - why people search for it - what makes it stand out Include the focus keyword naturally within the first 100 words. FEATURED SNIPPET SECTION Immediately after the introduction add: <h2>What is {{20.name}}?</h2> Provide a concise 40–50 word paragraph designed to rank for Google Featured Snippets. QUICK VERDICT BOX <blockquote> <strong>{{20.name}} Quick Verdict</strong> <p>Provide a short 2–3 sentence summary explaining the product’s value.</p> <ul> <li><strong>Best for:</strong> ideal type of user</li> <li><strong>Main advantage:</strong> strongest feature</li> <li><strong>Standout feature:</strong> key differentiator</li> <li><strong>Value rating:</strong> short evaluation</li> </ul> </blockquote> PRIMARY CTA <blockquote> <strong>Check Latest Price</strong> <p>If you want to see the latest deals and full specifications, visit the official product page.</p> <p><a href="{{20.permalink}}">See the current deal</a></p> </blockquote> <h2>Key Features of {{20.name}}</h2> List the most important features using bullet points. Each feature should briefly explain the benefit to the user. <h2>Technical Specifications</h2> Create a clean specification table. <table> <tr> <th>Specification</th> <th>Details</th> </tr> <tr> <td>Example</td> <td>Example</td> </tr> </table> Use realistic specifications typical for the product category. Do NOT fabricate unrealistic specifications. <h2>Performance and Real-World Usage</h2> Explain how the product performs in real usage. Discuss build quality, usability, reliability, and typical user experience. <h2>Benefits of {{20.name}}</h2> Explain the key benefits using bullet points. Focus on practical advantages. <h2>Pros and Cons</h2> <h3>Pros</h3> <ul> <li>Advantage</li> <li>Advantage</li> <li>Advantage</li> </ul> <h3>Cons</h3> <ul> <li>Limitation</li> <li>Limitation</li> </ul> <h2>{{20.name}} vs Similar Products</h2> Compare the product with similar items in the same category. Discuss differences in features, performance, and value. <h2>Best Alternatives</h2> Mention 2–3 competing products and briefly explain their strengths. <h2>Who Should Buy {{20.name}}?</h2> Use bullet points describing ideal buyers. Example: <ul> <li>Users who want...</li> <li>People looking for...</li> <li>Buyers who prioritize...</li> </ul> PEOPLE ALSO ASK SECTION <h2>Frequently Asked Questions</h2> Create 5 FAQ questions based on common user searches. Each answer must be 40–60 words. <h3>Question</h3> <p>Answer</p> <h3>Question</h3> <p>Answer</p> <h2>Final Verdict</h2> Provide a balanced conclusion highlighting strengths and limitations. FINAL CTA BLOCK <blockquote> <strong>Should You Buy {{20.name}}?</strong> <p>If you are looking for a reliable product in this category, {{20.name}} offers an excellent balance of features, performance, and value.</p> <p><a href="{{20.permalink}}">Check the latest price</a></p> </blockquote> Finish with a persuasive closing sentence encouraging readers to visit the product page.
